meta.name: sora
meta.description: Use when the user asks to generate, remix, poll, list, download, or delete Sora videos via OpenAI’s video API using the bundled CLI (`scripts/sora.py`), including requests like “generate AI video,” “Sora,” “video remix,” “download video/thumbnail/spritesheet,” and batch video generation; requires `OPENAI_API_KEY` and Sora API access.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 OpenAI 视频 API 生成、混剪和管理 Sora 视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量生成或编辑 AI 视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate, remix, and manage Sora videos via OpenAI's video API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch generate or edit AI videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 OpenAI 的 Sora API 生成、修改、查询、下载或删除短视频。它会自动将你的描述转为结构化提示，并调用命令行工具完成操作。
howto.when: 当你要求生成 AI 视频、提到“Sora”、需要视频混剪、下载视频/缩略图/精灵图，或批量生成视频时触发。需要先设置 OPENAI_API_KEY。

say.text: 帮我生成一段 4 秒的产品展示视频，黑色相机在转盘上。
把视频 vid_123 混剪成暖色调，保持镜头不变。
say.note: Claude 会使用 remix 功能修改已有视频。

say.text: 下载视频 vid_456 的缩略图。
say.note: Claude 会调用下载功能保存缩略图到本地。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate, remix, poll, list, download, or delete short videos via OpenAI's Sora API. It automatically structures your description into a prompt and runs the bundled CLI tool.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate AI video, mention "Sora", need video remix, download video/thumbnail/spritesheet, or batch video generation. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY to be set.

say_en.text: Generate a 4-second product demo video of a black camera on a turntable.
say_en.note: Claude will create a structured prompt and call the Sora API.

say_en.text: Remix video vid_123 to warm tones, keep the same shot.
say_en.note: Claude will use the remix feature to modify the existing video.

say_en.text: Download the thumbnail of video vid_456.
say_en.note: Claude will call the download function to save the thumbnail locally.
